title: Bridging Local and Population Causal Effects: A Proximal Instrumental Variable Approach
abstract: arXiv:2609.22383v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Instrumental variable (IV) methods address treatment endogeneity, but with non-compliance and heterogeneous treatment effects a binary instrument generally identifies the local average treatment effect (LATE) among compliers rather than the population average treatment effect (ATE). When treatment effects and compliance probabilities are heterogeneous and dependent through latent factors, the ATE need not be identified by IV variation alone. We develop a proximal instrumental variable framework that uses proxies for these factors to adjust for the compliance weighting in LATE and recover the ATE. We show that the ATE is identified through either an outcome bridge capturing latent treatment effect heterogeneity or a compliance bridge representing inverse compliance probabilities, and combining the two yields a doubly robust representation. We derive the efficient influence function under known and unknown instrument propensities. For es

translated_title: 弥合局部与总体因果效应：一种近端工具变量方法
translated_abstract: 工具变量（IV）方法用于处理分配的内生性问题，但在存在不依从和处理效应异质性的情况下，二元工具变量通常只能识别依从者中的局部平均处理效应（LATE），而非总体平均处理效应（ATE）。当处理效应与依从概率存在异质性，且二者通过潜在因素相互关联时，仅凭工具变量的变异可能不足以识别ATE。我们提出了一个近端工具变量框架，利用这些潜在因素的代理变量来校正LATE中的依从性加权，从而恢复出ATE。我们证明，ATE既可以通过捕捉潜在处理效应异质性的“结果桥”来识别，也可以通过表示逆依从概率的“依从桥”来识别，而将二者结合可得到双重稳健的表示。我们在工具倾向已知与未知的两种情形下推导了有效影响函数。对于估计……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种近端工具变量框架，利用潜在因素的代理变量（通过“结果桥”或“依从桥”识别，二者结合具有双重稳健性）来校正LATE中的依从性加权，使得二元工具变量在不依从与处理效应异质性并存的情形下也能识别总体平均处理效应（ATE）。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a proximal instrumental variable framework that uses proxies for latent factors—identified via an outcome bridge or a compliance bridge, doubly robust when combined—to adjust the compliance weighting in the LATE, enabling recovery of the population ATE with a binary instrument under non-compliance and heterogeneous treatment effects.
